items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I worked with Henry Hardin. I worked with Henry Hardin with Alvin's brother, George McCullough.

ctx.x: Gene Ware on trumpet. And Joe on piano. And he had a banjo player by the name of Walter, that's the last, I forgot Walter's other name, but he went to New York.
Didn't Henry Hardin have a band then? Yeah.
